claim_boundary: DIRAC-008 cumulatively proves the declared positive candidate action and complete prepared cube geometry, its local variations, the nonzero-timestep action update, an invariant sector with exact amplitude extraction and reconstruction, the exact local C19 character symbol of an explicitly constructed Bloch-modulated native Psi/chi state over a period-two ray background, an exact lossless equivalence between the two committed layers and current state plus backward interval velocity, and the complete reversible nonlinear first-order evolution map obtained by conjugating the unique action-stationary native update through that readout. The map acts on all thirty-two complex sector coordinates and its explicit Psi/chi displacement and velocity formulas are proved. The interval velocity is not claimed to be a same-time continuum derivative. The candidate action and prepared background are starting hypotheses, not derived origin claims. The chain does not yet prove a native invariant four-component selection, linearized Clifford algebra, free Dirac equation, electron, physical spin, formation or canonical framework.
